payload.name: Extract Brief Planned Gatherings and Events
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly mentions organizing, hosting, or planning an event or gathering, even briefly in small talk, during extraction.
content: During extraction, if a speaker explicitly says they are organizing, hosting, or planning an event or gathering (e.g., party, meetup, tournament, get-together), create an event candidate capturing the event, the organizer, and any explicit time reference, even when the mention is brief or embedded in a reply about someone else's plans.

Resolve relative time references (e.g., 'this weekend', 'two weekends later') using the message/session timestamp to an absolute date or at least the month, so future temporal questions can be answered.
Create one candidate per announced event and stop once the organizer, event, and time are captured; do not infer guests, location, or other details that are not explicitly stated.

solves: Construction misses explicit planned events or gatherings announced in small talk, especially when the speaker is replying to another person's plans. The system should extract the event, organizer, and a resolved time reference even from a brief sentence so future questions about what someone is organizing can be answered.
